provenancePolicy.facts: 300 readings grounded in linked official/open Japanese sources. This release adds 100 readings from 20 verified source families with 2026-first sourcing; one Beauty family uses a 2025 source because a distinct suitable 2026 source was not forced.
provenancePolicy.learnerText: Learner adaptations are clearly identified and are not presented as verbatim government prose.
provenancePolicy.attribution: Every record stores source title, publisher, URL, date, terms/license, attribution and edit notice.
provenancePolicy.assets: No source logos, photos, charts, videos, or separately credited third-party assets are included.
provenancePolicy.studyLevel: N5–N1 is Sakura study-support grading, not an official JLPT grade of the source.

sourceYearPolicy: 2026 first; if a category lacks suitable legally reusable 2026 material, use 2025, then 2024, then the newest verified legally reusable source available. Always display the actual source year.
packPolicy: Each level uses six 10-reading body shards plus a compact metadata index. Browsing/search reads indexes only; a full body shard is fetched only when a reading is opened. Body cache is bounded in memory.
